rules.statement: A District Judge presiding over a partition action should not wait for some lapse on the part of the plaintiff to dismiss the action and relieve himself of further responsibility.
rules.supporting_quote: A District Judge presiding over a partition action should not wait for some lapse on the part of the plaintiff to dismiss the action and relieve himself of further responsibility.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 70 of the Partition Law, No. 21 of 1977 read with section 839 of the Civil Procedure Code
